entries.verdict_line: Brent at $95.26 — a 5% surge in 30 days — hits India's import bill at ₹8,000 cr per $5 move while the RBI's inflation forecast of 4.6% was written at $90.
Nikkei at a 100th-percentile 64,325 — down 1,890 points in a session — while US 10Y hits 4.79%; global equity complacency is meeting its rate reckoning.
Airline passengers collapsed 9.5% MoM to a 7th-percentile 35M while GST hit ₹2.01 lakh crore — India's affluent are grounding themselves as mass consumption flies.

Copper at an 80th-percentile $6.67 — up four of five sessions — while India's PMI Services slips to 57.5 from 58.1; the commodity cycle is pricing a global recovery that India's own activity data is quietly walking back.
Retail mall vacancy at a 15th-percentile 6.7% — tightest in three years — while India VIX sits at a 5th-percentile 10.68; the affluent economy is fully priced, and nobody is hedging it.
Mumbai office rents at a 100th-percentile ₹335/sqft while absorption sits at a 6th-percentile 13.7 mn sqft — landlords are pricing a demand that tenants aren't showing up to confirm.

US 10Y at 4.95% — a 4-of-5-month climb to an 89th-percentile yield — is repricing every EM carry trade while India's DII flows hit an all-time high; domestic money is buying what foreign money is quietly exiting.
INR at 96.15 — a 91st-percentile print — is weakening despite record DII inflows, which means Brent at $103 is doing what foreign selling couldn't.

Nikkei at an all-time 100th-percentile 64,136 while US 10Y pierces 5.01% — global equities are pricing a soft landing that the bond market is simultaneously pricing as impossible.
RBI's inflation forecast just jumped 50bps to 5.1% — yet repo sits at 5.25%, leaving a real rate of 15bps that is too thin to anchor a currency at a 91st-percentile 96.15.

S&P 500 at an all-time 100th-percentile 7,650 while copper rises for the fourth consecutive month to $6.69 — global markets are pricing a capex supercycle that India's own IIP data is only beginning to confirm.

DII equity net at ₹58,502 Cr — a 100th-percentile print rising for two consecutive months — is domestic capital voting with conviction precisely when FIIs were net sellers three sessions ago.

Nikkei at an all-time 66,364 while US 10Y climbs to 5.18% — global equities are pricing perpetual expansion precisely as bond markets price the cost of it.

Bank Nifty at 89th-percentile 54,472 while India VIX jumps to 13.6 — markets are pricing strength precisely as volatility signals the first crack.
